meanings.note: Prefix 'при-' indicates approaching, attachment, or slight degree of action (stem 'ехать'). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to arrive (by vehicle)', paired with 'приезжать'.

examples.trans: Which car did you come in?

examples.text: Вика, ты на какой машине сегодня приехала?
examples.trans: Vika, which car did you come in today?

Spoken exchange. Prefix 'раз-' ('apart, un-, thoroughly') indicates distribution or intensive action (stem 'говор'). Common masculine noun meaning 'conversation, talk' in everyday Russian.

examples.text: У нас с тобой серьёзный разговор.
examples.trans: You and I have a serious talk to have.

examples.text: Есть интересный разговор. Всё хорошо, малыш.

examples.trans: The boys will have a word with you.

meanings.note: Plural: дети. Formed with a diminutive/expressive Slavic suffix adding warmth or small scale. Common masculine noun meaning 'child' in everyday Russian.
Prefix 'с-' ('together' or 'down from') marks convergence or completion (stem 'делать'). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to do, to make', paired with 'делать'.

examples.text: Мы сделали много, но надо сделать ещё больше.
examples.trans: We've done a lot, but we need to do even more.

meanings.note: 'сейчас буду' = I'll be right there
Prefix 'с-' ('together' or 'down from') marks convergence or completion (stem 'ейчас').

examples.text: Конечно, помогу. Кто у вас сейчас начальник?
examples.trans: Of course I'll help. Who's your boss now?

meanings.note: Смотреть на + accusative. Prefix 'с-' ('together' or 'down from') marks convergence or completion (stem 'мотреть'). Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'to look, to watch', paired with 'посмотреть'.

meanings.note: Совершенно верно = quite right. Prefix 'с-' ('together' or 'down from') marks convergence or completion (stem 'овершенно'). Manner/predicative adverb in '-о', derived from the neuter short form of the corresponding adjective.

examples.text: Совершенно верно, я мэр этого города.
examples.trans: Quite right, I am the mayor of this town.
